illness_away_active_ge1_on_production_op.classification_evidence: Opener primary: -0.439 accuracy points, week-blocked probability_positive 0.312. Neither terminal ground applies: wrong_sign_resolved requires the whole interval on the wrong side, reliability is 0.702 rather than zero, and the +43.860-point positive control demonstrates detection but does not bound this effect. Therefore unresolved_below_power.
illness_away_active_ge1_on_production_op.description: Opener-grade confirmation: predeclared away active-illness count at least one on top of production weak_stack versus production unmodified, paired forced-pick probability-rule accuracy.
illness_away_active_ge1_on_production_op.notes: Primary opener probability rule; 456 paired non-push games, 35 weeks, assigned 2020-2021 window. Baseline 53.728%, candidate 53.289%; 17 picks differ. Week 95% [-2.655,+1.532], P+ 0.312. Frozen-pick within-week null center -0.378 points; observed -0.439 is 44.5th percentile. Positive control +43.860 points, P+1.000.
illness_away_active_ge1_on_production_op.plain_summary: Telling the model that at least one visiting player was active with an illness changed seventeen opener picks and was slightly worse on this two-season card. The evidence is unresolved, so it is recorded rather than closed.
